Marta,

I need to know which drivers are affected by the mobilization so I can rebuild the rotas. Please send me the names as soon as you have them, since I can't start on the trucks and schedules until I know who is available.

The rotas must be published by 27/11/2026.

Tomas

Tomas Berek
Operations Manager
Kestrel Haulage Ltd
